intro.title: Build CSV export endpoint with streaming
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a Node.js API endpoint that exports data as a CSV file using streaming. You will learn how to use Node.js streams to efficiently generate and send large CSV files without consuming excessive memory. The core concept involves creating a readable stream for the CSV data and piping it directly to the HTTP response. You will work with the built-in `stream` module and the `csv-writer` library to structure the data. By the end, you will have a functional endpoint that streams CSV data to the client on demand.
intro.usecase: Streaming CSV export endpoints are essential for handling large datasets in production applications, such as financial reporting dashboards or e-commerce analytics platforms. For example, when a user clicks 'Export to CSV' on an admin panel displaying thousands of sales records, this pattern allows the server to send data incrementally, preventing memory overload and enabling immediate download initiation. Developers implement this to support features like real-time data exports from user-filtered tables or scheduled report generation in background jobs, ensuring efficient resource usage and a responsive user experience even with massive data volumes.
